name: Kaioken Scan
summary: Structural module for kaioken/scan. Scans a repository tree, walks directories respecting layered ignore rules, detects language, classifies risk (private keys, credentials, generated files, lockfiles, large binaries), and writes/reads a scan.json artifact. The scan result is a list of FileRecords with hash and risk annotations, capped by read-size budgets to avoid choking on large repos.
keyPoints: Artifact lifecycle: `writeScanArtifact`/`readScanArtifact`/`scanArtifactPath` persist the scan result to `<root>/.kaioken/scan.json` (const `KAIOKEN_DIR`/`SCAN_ARTIFACT` in artifact.ts).

Ignore handling: `IgnoreStack` merges default ignores (`.git/`, `node_modules/`, etc.), per-directory `.gitignore`/`.kaiokenignore` files, and case-insensitive options. Layers build on each other so child dirs can add patterns but not remove parent ones (ignore.ts).

Language detection: `detectLanguage` uses extension maps (`BY_EXTENSION`), filename maps (`BY_FILENAME`), and shebang interpreter lookup (`BY_INTERPRETER`, via `languageFromShebang`) — covers 50+ extensions and common scripts (language.ts).

Risk classification: `classifyRisk` returns `private_key`, `credentials`, `generated`, `large_binary`, `lockfile` based on filename/content regexes (AWS keys, JWTs, bearer tokens, generated banners) and size thresholds; helper predicates `hasPrivateKeyContent`, `hasCredentialContent`, `looksLikeLiveSecret`, `isBinary` (risk.ts).

Scan pipeline: `scan` walks the tree (`walk`) using an `IgnoreStack`, reads files (cap at `DEFAULT_MAX_READ_BYTES`), streams hash and secret scanning (max `DEFAULT_MAX_SECRET_SCAN_BYTES`), and produces a `ScanResult` of `FileRecord` entries (scan.ts).
